keySummary.text: 普朗克在目标区域为一个火药桶开盖。如果他攻击火药桶，那么火药桶会爆炸，将这次攻击的伤害传播到范围内的敌人身上，并将他们减速。

keyTooltip.text:
普朗克放置一个可被普朗克和敌方英雄攻击的火药桶，该火药桶持续@BarrelDuration@秒。当一名敌人将火药桶摧毁时，该火药桶会哑火。当普朗克将火药桶摧毁时，该火药桶会爆炸，造成持续@DebuffDuration@秒的@FinalSlowAmount@%减速和相当于攻击力的伤害，并无视@BarrelArmorPenetration@%护甲。英雄会受到额外的@BonusDamageToChampions@物理伤害。

火药桶的生命值会每@BarrelDecayTime@秒衰减一次。火药桶会引爆其它爆炸区域与它有重叠的火药桶，但不会重复对相同目标造成伤害。火药桶的爆炸可通过{{Spell_GangplankQWrapper_Name}}来触发并在击杀目标们时提供额外金币。

keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine.text: <rules>火药桶生命值的衰减速率会在7级和13级时提升。</rules>

officialZh.name: 火药桶
officialZh.description: 普朗克在目标区域为一个火药桶开盖。如果他攻击火药桶，那么火药桶会爆炸，将这次攻击的伤害传播到范围内的敌人身上，并将他们减速。
officialZh.tooltip:
普朗克放置一个可被普朗克和敌方英雄攻击的火药桶，该火药桶持续{{ barrelduration }}秒。当一名敌人将火药桶摧毁时，该火药桶会哑火。当普朗克将火药桶摧毁时，该火药桶会爆炸，造成持续{{ debuffduration }}秒的{{ finalslowamount }}%减速和相当于攻击力的伤害，并无视{{ barrelarmorpenetration }}%护甲。英雄会受到额外的{{ bonusdamagetochampions }}物理伤害。

火药桶的生命值会每{{ barreldecaytime }}秒衰减一次。火药桶会引爆其它爆炸区域与它有重叠的火药桶，但不会重复对相同目标造成伤害。火药桶的爆炸可通过枪火谈判来触发并在击杀目标们时提供额外金币。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEn.name: Powder Keg
officialEn.description: Gangplank uncovers a powder keg at target location. If he attacks it, it explodes, spreading the attack's damage to enemies in the area, slowing them.
officialEn.tooltip:
Gangplank places a powder keg that can be attacked by Gangplank and enemy champions for {{ barrelduration }} seconds. When an enemy destroys it, the keg is defused. When Gangplank destroys it, it explodes, Slowing by {{ finalslowamount }}% for {{ debuffduration }} seconds and dealing the Attack's damage, ignoring {{ barrelarmorpenetration }}% Armor. Champions take an additional {{ bonusdamagetochampions }} physical damage.

Keg health decays every {{ barreldecaytime }} seconds. Keg explosions detonate other kegs with overlapping blast zones, but don't deal damage to the same target more than once. Keg explosions triggered by Parrrley will grant the bonus gold for targets killed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEn.name: Cannon Barrage
officialEn.description: Gangplank signals his ship to bombard an area, slowing and damaging enemies.
officialEn.tooltip:
Gangplank signals his ship to fire {{ totalwavestooltip }} waves of cannonballs anywhere on the map over {{ zoneduration }} seconds. Each wave Slows by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds and deals {{ onewavedamage }} magic damage. Maximum damage: {{ totaldamagetooltip }}

keyTooltip.text:
千珏可以指名一位英雄作为狩猎目标，方法是点击该英雄在其物品栏上的肖像。它们也会指名某些野怪作为狩猎目标，会自动在小地图上显示为一个图标。

参与击杀被狩猎的目标后，会为千珏提供一层印记，来使其获得强化。在@InitialMarkThreshold@层印记后，获得@FirstTierRangeIncreaseTT@攻击距离。之后的每@AdditionalMarkThreshold@层印记会提供@RangeIncrease@攻击距离。

印记会强化千珏的基础技能：
  • {{Spell_KindredQ_Name}}获得额外的@QMarkBonus@攻击速度
  • {{Spell_KindredW_Name}}造成额外的@WMarkBonus@当前生命值伤害。
  • {{Spell_KindredEWrapper_Name}}造成额外的@EMarkBonus@已损失生命值伤害。

keySummary.text: 千珏可以标记敌人进行狩猎。成功完成一次狩猎，将永久强化千珏的基础技能。每完成4次狩猎，还会提升千珏的普攻距离。

{{Spell_KindredPassiveManager_Tooltip}}

当前提供@f1@攻击距离。

If enemies hit are already bleeding from this Ability, it instead deals the remaining bleed damage plus between {{ spell.naafiriq:totalmindamagesecondcast }} and {{ spell.naafiriq:totalmaxdamagesecondcast }} physical damage, based on their missing Health. If that target was a champion or large monster, Naafiri restores {{ spell.naafiriq:totalhealsecondcast }} Health.

keySummary.text: 劫变为不可被选取状态并突进至一名敌方英雄，同时为目标施加死亡印记。在3秒后，印记将会爆炸，同时造成额外伤害，劫在印记激活期间造成的伤害越多，则此额外伤害越高。如果该英雄死于此技能期间，那么劫可以获得该英雄的一部分攻击力。

keyTooltip.text:
劫变得不可被选取，突进向一位敌方英雄，并将其标记。@RDeathMarkDuration@秒后，标记会触发，对目标造成@RCalculatedDamage@物理伤害，加上印记激活期间劫所造成的伤害总和的@RDamageAmp*100@%。

突进会留下一个影分身在身后，持续@RShadowDurationDisplayed@秒。再次施放此技能会使劫与这个影分身互换位置。

keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine.text:
{{Reminder_Untargetable}}
影分身会在再次施放的时间窗口结束后存留额外的1.5秒。

officialZh.name: 禁奥义！瞬狱影杀阵
officialZh.description: 劫变为不可被选取状态并突进至一名敌方英雄，同时为目标施加死亡印记。在3秒后，印记将会爆炸，同时造成额外伤害，劫在印记激活期间造成的伤害越多，则此额外伤害越高。如果该英雄死于此技能期间，那么劫可以获得该英雄的一部分攻击力。
officialZh.tooltip:
劫变得不可被选取，突进向一位敌方英雄，并将其标记。{{ rdeathmarkduration }}秒后，标记会触发，对目标造成{{ rcalculateddamage }}物理伤害，加上印记激活期间劫所造成的伤害总和的{{ rdamageamp*100 }}%。

突进会留下一个影分身在身后，持续{{ rshadowdurationdisplayed }}秒。再次施放此技能会使劫与这个影分身互换位置。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEn.name: Death Mark
officialEn.description: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds the mark triggers, repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked.
officialEn.tooltip:
Zed becomes Untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After {{ rdeathmarkduration }} seconds, the mark triggers, dealing {{ rcalculateddamage }} physical damage and repeating {{ rdamageamp*100 }}% of all damage dealt to the target by Zed while the mark was active.

The dash leaves a Shadow behind for {{ rshadowdurationdisplayed }} seconds. Zed can Recast this Ability to switch positions with this Shadow.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
